Theme

Latin word

negōtium

negōtium, negōtiī n.

noun, second declension

business, dealings; an affair; a business, as an establishment; trouble, bother: quid est negōtī?, what’s the problem?

In this lexicon

  • business

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Fam. 1.3.1: magna negōtia et ampla et expedīta habet; Traupman 131, 165; Traupman 285

  • company

    also used · modern · Traupman 165

  • problem

    also used · classical · Plaut. Most. 741: sed quid est negōtī?; Cic. Att. 10.16.3: nūllō negōtiō, without any trouble; Traupman 91, 106, 364; Traupman 106: what’s the problem?, quid est negōtī?

  • suum negōtium agere: business

    classical
